newsitem.title: FRANCE: Egypt buys at least 300,000 T Australian wheat.
newsitem.headline: Egypt buys at least 300,000 T Australian wheat.

text.p: Egypt on Sunday bought at least 300,000 tonnes of Australian wheat at prices below $145 per tonne, fob, European grain traders said on Monday.
The wheat was for shipment in February, they said.
One exporter estimated that Egypt had bought between 300,000 and 350,000 tonnes of wheat but another exporter put the purchase as high as 400,000 tonnes.
Traders said the price for the deals was below $145 per tonne fob, though one said Australia may have sold the wheat for considerably less -- "close to $140".
Samir Shakankiri, vice-chairman of the General Authority for Supply Commodities, said in Cairo on Sunday Egypt had bought standard soft white Australian wheat but gave no price or quantity.
On Sunday Egypt also bought 200,000 tonnes of Argentine wheat at prices ranging from $130.97-132.00 per tonne fob for January and February loading.
Exporters put Egypt's import needs at 450,000 tonnes per month and said these now appeared to be covered until the end of February.
